classification.difficultyReason: The frustum requires treating its curved surface as a complete cone minus the removed cone, finding both slant heights using Pythagoras, and adding the exposed circular faces. Other parts require excluding internal joins.

content.prompt: Calculate the surface area of these composite solids. Answer to 1 d.p.

spec.description: Two congruent cones joined at their circular bases, with separate perpendicular-height dimensions, a radius leader and a right-angle construction.
spec.mathematics: Shared radius 7 cm; upper and lower perpendicular heights both 15 cm. The shared circular base is internal.
spec.answerVisibility: Givens only; no calculated slant height or area.

answer.worked:
The shared circular base is internal, so only the two curved surfaces are exposed.
$$\begin{align*}l^2&=15^2+7^2\\l&=\sqrt{274}\text{ cm}\\A&=\pi(7)\sqrt{274}+\pi(7)\sqrt{274}\\A&=14\pi\sqrt{274}\\A&\approx728.0\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$

children.prompt: The lower circular face has diameter $12\text{ cm}$.

spec.description: Closed conical frustum with dashed extensions to the original apex, a central axis, lower-base diameter construction and perpendicular-height dimensions.
spec.mathematics: Upper diameter 4 cm, lower diameter 12 cm, removed-cone perpendicular height 9 cm and frustum perpendicular height 18 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Givens only; removed cone shown as construction.

answer.worked:
The radii are $2\text{ cm}$ and $6\text{ cm}$. The complete cone has perpendicular height $9+18=27\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}L^2&=27^2+6^2=765\\L&=\sqrt{765}\text{ cm}\\l^2&=9^2+2^2=85\\l&=\sqrt{85}\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
Top circle: $\pi(2)^2\text{ cm}^2$.

Bottom circle: $\pi(6)^2\text{ cm}^2$.

Curved surface: $\pi(6)\sqrt{765}-\pi(2)\sqrt{85}\text{ cm}^2$.
$$\begin{align*}A&=\pi(2)^2+\pi(6)^2+\pi(6)\sqrt{765}-\pi(2)\sqrt{85}\\A&\approx589.1\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Cone on a square-based rectangular prism. Its circular base is inscribed in the square top. Double ticks identify equal front and depth edges.
spec.mathematics: Square side 8 m, prism height 3 m and cone slant height 10 m. Cone radius is 4 m. Circular contact surfaces are internal.

answer.worked:
The cone has radius $8\div2=4\text{ m}$. Exclude the circular join from the prism surface and add the cone’s curved surface.
$$\begin{align*}A_{\text{prism}}&=2(8\times8)+4(8\times3)\\A_{\text{prism}}&=224\text{ m}^2\\A&=224-\pi(4)^2+\pi(4)(10)\\A&=224+24\pi\\A&\approx299.4\text{ m}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Cone on a square-based rectangular prism. Its circular base is inscribed in the square top. Double ticks identify equal front and depth edges.
spec.mathematics: Square side 10 mm, prism height 6 mm and cone slant height 9 mm. Cone radius is 5 mm. Circular contact surfaces are internal.

answer.worked:
The cone has radius $10\div2=5\text{ mm}$. Exclude the circular join from the prism surface and add the cone’s curved surface.
$$\begin{align*}A_{\text{prism}}&=2(10\times10)+4(10\times6)\\A_{\text{prism}}&=440\text{ mm}^2\\A&=440-\pi(5)^2+\pi(5)(9)\\A&=440+20\pi\\A&\approx502.8\text{ mm}^2\end{align*}$$
